question: Which is the world's first handwritten needle book?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tavern**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tavern** is recognized as the world's first handwritten needle book.
 
• The needle book contains a collection of sewing needles of various sizes and types, all meticulously handwritten with descriptions and uses.
 
• This unique artifact reflects the craftsmanship and attention to detail of its creator, making it a significant piece in the history of sewing and needlework.
 
• It serves as a valuable resource for understanding the historical context and evolution of sewing tools and techniques.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **needle book** is a testament to the artistry and skill involved in traditional needlework.
 
• Handwritten needle books are rare and often considered collector's items due to their historical and cultural significance.
 
• Such books not only provided practical information for users but also showcased the aesthetic and artistic sensibilities of their time.
 
• The tradition of creating needle books has evolved, but the essence of preserving and organizing sewing needles remains an important aspect of the craft.
